series.title: Wild Encounter

qc.notes:
SERIES EXEMPTION, READ THIS FIRST: this series is a FAKE BEHIND-THE-SCENES of a film shoot. A giant creature stands on a soundstage and is revealed at the end to be a built practical prop. Ignore the words "impossible anatomy" and "chimera" in your artifact_score definition FOR THAT CREATURE: it is the subject of the clip, not a defect, and it must NEVER raise artifact_score. Reserve the numeric artifact_score for UNINTENDED generation defects only: the man, his hands, his face, the crew, the floor or the studio structure melting, duplicating, breaking or glitching.

THE SET MUST READ IN THE FIRST FRAME. A green screen wall, crew in black, and the backs of camera operators with monitors in the foreground must be visible from the opening moment. A shot that looks like a real outdoor location instead of a studio set is a FAIL: the whole format depends on the viewer seeing that this is a film shoot.

THREE SHOTS, ONE CONTINUOUS SCENE, SAME SET. The three beats are a single story and the order never changes:
SHOT 1 is the THREAT: the creature reaches toward the man, who stands and watches it. The creature must be LARGE and CLOSE, filling much of the frame. A small or distant creature is a FAIL; the scale is what carries this format.
SHOT 2 is TAKEN INSIDE: the creature's arms wrap the man, lift him and draw him INTO its body until he is COMPLETELY out of sight. A shot that ends with the man still visible is a FAIL. This beat is what makes the reveal land: the viewer must see him go in.
SHOT 3 is the PRACTICAL REVEAL: a hatch opens in the creature's body and the man climbs out unharmed while crew applaud. A shot that ends without showing the creature is a prop is a FAIL.
WITHOUT SHOT 2 THE STORY BREAKS. An earlier two-shot version went straight from threat to reveal and the owner reported it as disconnected: the audience never saw him go in, so coming out meant nothing.

THERE IS NO TRANSFORMATION IN THIS SERIES. Nothing morphs, nothing fuses. A creature that changes shape is a FAIL. This was measured: the model cannot fuse two bodies, and that failure is why this format was chosen.

ONE MAN ONLY, in both shots. One face, two hands, five fingers each. A second copy of him anywhere is an automatic fail. His face must match the reference: Turkish man, warm olive skin, full neatly groomed black beard, thick dark eyebrows, short dark hair. A different face is an automatic fail; this is the single most important check. Crew members in the background are expected and are NOT copies of him.

He NEVER speaks and never moves his mouth as if talking; there is no narration. A posed look into the lens is a fail; watching the creature or the crew is correct.

Studio equipment, rigging, cables, monitors and camera bodies in frame are EXPECTED and are not defects. Only subtitle bars, captions or watermark-style graphics laid over the footage count as unwanted text. Water spray, haze and lens flare are INTENDED realism.

Both shots are the SAME set and the SAME light. A drifting viewpoint inside a shot is a continuity observation, not a defect score; record it under issues in plain words.
qc.object_match_note: 2026-09-10 KAPALI, gerekcesi: produce.py:1093 ensure_episode_refs YALNIZ tek-obje-4x6 formatinda obje referansi uretiyor. Ayrica cekim 1'de yaratik BILEREK yari gizli oldugu icin tam referansla eslestirme testi dogasi geregi gurultulu olurdu. qc.first_frame_note: 2026-09-11 KAPALI. Yeni uc-vurusta CEKIM 1 BILEREK SIRADAN bir hayvandir; imkansiz ozellik orada YOKTUR. require_first_frame yalniz cekim 1'i denetliyor ve 'izleyici acilis karesinde imkansiz ozelligi okuyamiyor' diyerek her seferinde reddederdi. Ilk denemede tam bu oldu ve 315 kredi yandi. Imkansizlik cekim 3'un isidir.
qc.continuity_note: 2026-09-11 KAPALI. Uc-vurus yapisinda cekim 1 orman nehri, cekim 2 kayalik kiyi, cekim 3 tropik sahilde geciyor; mekan ve isik BILEREK degisiyor. require_continuity cekimler arasi mekan/isik/obje-durumu surekliligi ariyor ve bu formatta HER SEFERINDE cekim 3'u reddediyor (olculdu: iki deneme, 168 kredi). QC notuna 'farkli mekanlar beklenir' yazmak YETMEDI, cunku bu ayri bir sert bayrak. Yaratik tutarliligi object_card'daki acik tur/renk/isaret tarifiyle ve (planlanan) karakter kaydiyla saglanir.

series.format_note: 2026-09-10, olculerek kuruldu. Kaynak: sentinal_ihsan/TERSINE-MUHENDISLIK.md. Referans videolar (Ihsan'in IG Insights sayilari): 11,9M = 18,9 sn ve 1 kesme; 4,4M = 15,2 sn ve 0 kesme; 290K = 10,1 sn ve 1 kesme. Dordunde de SIFIR konusma, ses -14,1 ila -14,5 LUFS, cozunurluk 720x1280. Bizim karsiligimiz: 2 cekim x 8 saniye = 16 saniye, 1 kesme. Ayni hesabin dusen videolari 24-32 saniye ve 17 kesmeye cikmisti; bu yuzden duration_band tavani 20 saniyede KAPALI tutuluyor.
series.chain_note: 2026-09-11 GERI ACILDI. Yapi artik TEK SAHNE, TEK MEKAN: iki hayvan ayni kadrajda birlesiyor, sonra melez kovaliyor. Zincirleme cekim 2'yi cekim 1'in son karesinden baslatir, yani fuzyondan kovalamaya akis kopmaz. Uc ayri mekanli onceki tasarimda zincir KAPALIYDI cunku ormani ahtapot cekimine tasiyordu; o tasarim referans videonun 2 fps incelemesiyle CURUTULDU.
series.credit_cap_note: 2026-09-11: gecici 1300 tavani GERI ALINDI, 1000'e donuldu. Bolum 1'de 1239 kredi birikmisti cunku UC AYRI KONSEPT (ayi-yengec, kaplan-ahtapot, fil-timsah) hep part01 olarak uretildi; defter hepsini tek bolume yazdi. DERS: her tasarim yinelemesi YENI BOLUM NUMARASI almali, yoksa hem tavan yaniltir hem maliyet muhasebesi bozulur.
series.duration_note: 2026-09-11: tavan 20 -> 26. Ihsan daha UZUN video istedi ve hikayenin uc vurusu (tehdit, yutulma, ifsa) 24 saniye gerektiriyor. NOT, olcumle celisiyor: referans hesabin videolari 24-32 saniyeye cikinca medyani 2.161'den 325 begeniye dusmustu. Ama o olcum KOVALAMA formati icindi; bu format referansi (DckORL2B8gx) 15,2 sn ve 4,4M. 24 saniye ikisinin arasinda. Karar Ihsan'in, gerekce kayda gecti.

art_style: Vertical 9:16 photoreal wildlife footage shot on a handheld camera in a real outdoor location: beach, jungle, river, desert or open water, in natural daylight. Grounded documentary look with slight handheld shake, real depth of field, sun haze and visible atmosphere. Colours are natural and slightly desaturated, never stylised or cinematic-graded. Exactly ONE hybrid creature is present and it behaves like a real animal; everything else in the world obeys ordinary physics.

characters.name: Ihsan
characters.bio: Kanalin yuzu, Ihsan'in kendi figuru. Her bolumde gercek bir dogal mekanda imkansiz bir melez yaratikla karsilasir. Rolu TANIK: olayi yasayan, tepki veren, bazen kacan kisidir. Kamerada ASLA konusmaz ve agzini konusur gibi oynatmaz; bu seride anlatim YOKTUR, ses yalniz ortam sesi ve kisik muzik yatagidir. Yuzu ve govdesi kadrajda NET gorunur, kameraya degil yaratiga bakar. Kiyafeti bolumden bolume MEKANA GORE degisir (sahilde dalgic ustu, ormanda saha ceketi, colde acik renk gomlek); degismeyen sey adamin KENDISIDIR.
characters.appearance: A 30-year-old Turkish man with warm olive skin, dark brown eyes, thick dark eyebrows, and a full, neatly groomed black beard and moustache. Short dark brown-black hair. Athletic lean-muscular build with broad shoulders, visibly fit. His expression is alarm and disbelief: eyes wide, mouth slightly open, body tensed or already turning away. He is dressed appropriately for the location of the episode, in practical outdoor clothing that fits that environment. No visible tattoos, no watch, no jewellery. Hands anatomically correct: exactly two hands, five fingers each. Realistic, grounded, handheld-camera look.

environments.desc: A wide tropical beach in bright daylight: wet sand at the waterline reflecting the sky, small breaking waves, palm trees blurred at the far edge of frame, scattered white cloud over open sea.
A slow brown river cutting through dense jungle: thick green foliage crowding both banks, hanging vines, humid haze in the air, dappled sunlight breaking through the canopy onto the water.
An open desert of pale wind-carved dunes under a hard blue sky: fine sand streaming off the ridges, heat shimmer near the ground, a few dark rocks half buried in the slope.
A dark volcanic rock shelf at the edge of deep open water: spray bursting against the rock, foam sliding back into the sea, grey-green swell moving beyond, overcast maritime light.

A large film studio soundstage: a tall bright green screen wall across the back, a shallow water tank in the middle of the floor, overhead lighting grid and scaffolding above, and crew members in black standing along the far edge of the set.

A built jungle set inside a film studio: dense practical foliage, hanging vines and wet leaf litter across the floor, low drifting haze, a tall green screen wall visible beyond the foliage, and an overhead studio lighting grid shining down through the canopy from a high glass-roofed structure.
